actor_prompts.actor_1: Standing in place with knees soft, raise a compact martial-arts guard. Make a sharp shoulder feint, then two crisp forearm guard changes close to the chest without striking. Finish balanced with hands raised.
actor_prompts.actor_2: Standing in place with hands loosely raised, bend the knees into a shallow duck, then lean the torso slightly back with a clear startled expression. Straighten into a balanced compact guard without stepping.

actor_prompts.actor_1: From the raised guard, make a shallow knee dip and a small sideways torso lean, keeping both feet planted. Return upright with a crisp shoulder reset and hold a balanced guard.
actor_prompts.actor_2: From the compact guard, make a sharp shoulder feint followed by two angular forearm guard changes close to the chest without striking. Add a small forward weight shift, then settle upright with hands raised.

actor_prompts.actor_1: From the guard, relax the shoulders and lower the hands. Give an emphatic nod, lift both open hands overhead in celebration, then lower the arms and finish standing comfortably in place.
actor_prompts.actor_2: From the guard, release the shoulders and open the hands. Make two gentle rhythmic knee pulses while raising both arms into a celebratory V, then lower the arms and finish standing comfortably in place.
